claims.content: To enable the Business Owner to use the reports available via the Auction Admin Main Menu page for flexible reporting to operate the business.

goal.raw_text: To enable the Business Owner to use the reports available via the Auction Admin Main Menu page for flexible reporting to operate the business.

claims.content: Business Owner
The Business Owner has access to the Auction Administration (“AA”) application.
The Business Owner has access to the Auction Admin Main Menu page.
Flexible reporting is available to the business owner via the Auction Admin Main Menu page.
The supporting / underlying database discussed in section 9 is available for the reports.
The Business Owner accesses the Auction Admin Main Menu page, where the flexible reporting reports are available to the business owner.

trigger.raw_text: The Business Owner accesses the Auction Admin Main Menu page, where the flexible reporting reports are available to the business owner.

claims.content: The Business Owner accesses the Auction Admin Main Menu page.

The Business Owner selects one of the reports available in the Reports Menu: Status of Current Auctions, Sales Report, Competition Report, RFM Report, Customer Ranking Report, Inventory Performance & Aging Report, or Omniture Reports, each accompanied by a GO ▶ button.
The reports use the supporting / underlying database discussed in section 9.
For the Current Auctions Status Page (Daily View), the Business Owner monitors the expected performance for future days’ auctions.
The Business Owner switches between the hourly view and the daily view.
The Business Owner chooses to view only gemstone auctions, only jewelry auctions, or all auctions.
The page shows the closing date.

The Business Owner selects the Auctions RFM Report; the Recency section is split into six tiers (0-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, 91-180 days, 181-365 days, and over 365 days) and shows the total number of accounts that have made a purchase transaction in each time range, as well as the revenue and orders amounts.
The Business Owner switches to the hourly view.
The Business Owner chooses to view only gemstone auctions.
The Business Owner chooses to view only jewelry auctions.
The Business Owner chooses to view all auctions.
The reports are available to the business owner via the Auction Admin Main Menu page.
The reports use the supporting / underlying database as discussed in section 9.
The reports all use the same Auction Admin global header.

For the Current Auctions Status Page (Daily View), the page allows the user to switch between the hourly view and the daily view, and choose to view only gemstone auctions, only jewelry auctions, or all auctions.

For the Current Auctions Status Page (Hourly View), the page shows the closing date & time (broken down by hour), the total bids on all items closing on that date/time, the total cost of all items closing on that date/time, the # of items scheduled to close, the total # of bidders so far, the average unit cost per auction, the total number of bids placed so far, and the average number of bids placed per item so far.
